svg.title: What each WebUI page extracts
svg.desc: A matrix of the structured blocks, Unity classes and indexes each export.bat page extracts with --from-game, and the optional publication reads between independent pages: each arrow points from the page that publishes the data to the page that reads it.
svg.text: export.bat PAGE --from-game exports the union of the named pages' inputs. Every cell is declared per build task in scripts/webui/pages.py.
required: must exist and be current
read when present, else the page degrades
read when present; another mode or page extracts it
shown as files by the Data page
story extracts text only; story-media adds its images and videos; voice lines come from Audio. Data shows every output the other pages do not, undecoded blocks as bytes.
No page named (every column) extracts the same as debug. Asset maps are refreshed by every Unity export; MonoBehaviour and PlayableDirector are exported together with the object index.
Which pages read another page's output
Each page builds independently and writes only its own files. Arrows show publication reads; the arrowhead is the reader.
Selected producers run first in a shared export.
Otherwise the reader uses their last output.
The page fetches the last published output.
The builder reads an existing publication.
Data runs first when both pages are selected.
Last published encounter and skill datasets
Table catalog with reused media; no other page is built or read.
Recipes, encyclopedia groups and uses come from Tables; available exported images supply icons.
Optional or missing publications reduce the displayed detail; they never cause a page to rebuild another page.
Updates compares two complete exports (build_updates.bat OLD NEW) and is not part of export.bat.
